en.headline: Hang Seng closes down 148 points, extending five-day slide
en.dek: The benchmark finished at 24,805 on Friday on turnover of HK$228.43 billion, taking the weekly loss to about 3.3 percent amid rate concerns and thinner volumes.
body: Hong Kong stocks ended lower on Friday, with the Hang Seng Index closing down 148 points, or 0.6 percent, at 24,805, extending its losing streak to a fifth consecutive session.

Turnover reached HK$228.43 billion. The Hang Seng Tech Index slipped 0.2 percent and the China Enterprises Index fell 0.3 percent. On the mainland, the Shanghai Composite closed 1.18 percent lower at 3,888.

Market participants pointed to subdued trading volumes and growing expectations of further US interest-rate moves as factors weighing on risk appetite. The benchmark was down about 3.3 percent for the week.
Energy names provided some support earlier in the day on firmer oil prices, but technology and property counters remained under pressure.

zh.headline: 恒指收報24805點跌148點 連跌五日全周累跌約3.3%
zh.dek: 周五成交228.43億元，科技指數及國企指數同步偏軟，內地滬指跌逾1%。
body: 港股周五低收，恒生指數下跌148點或0.6%，報24,805點，連跌五日。
全日成交228.43億元。恒生科技指數跌0.2%，國企指數跌0.3%。內地滬綜指收市跌1.18%，報3,888點。
市場指交投淡靜及對美國利率前景的憂慮拖累氣氛，恒指全周累跌約3.3%。
早段油價上升令能源股提供部分支持，但科技及地產股仍偏弱。
